app.title: Wordle
app.description: Challenge yourself with the classic word guessing game. Play daily challenges, compete on leaderboards, try themed modes, and track your stats.

game.hintConfirmTitle: Do you want to enable hints?
game.hintConfirmDesc: You'll be able to see the word's definition.
game.howToPlayDesc: Guess the word in 6 tries. After each guess, the color of the tiles will change to show how close your guess was to the word.
game.howCorrect: is in the word and in the correct spot.
game.howPresent: is in the word but in the wrong spot.
game.howAbsent: is not in the word in any spot.
game.hardModeFirstTime: Hard Mode: Revealed hints (green/yellow letters) must be used in all future guesses. Good luck!
game.hardModeLocked: Modes can only be changed at the start of a game
game.blindModeFirstTime: Blind Mode: All tile colors are hidden until the game ends. You won't see any feedback until you win or lose!
game.loadError: Could not load word. Check your connection.

daily.title: Daily Challenge
daily.desc: A new word every day. Everyone gets the same word — guess it in 6 tries and compete on the leaderboard!
daily.loginRequired: You need to login to play the daily challenge.
daily.playTodayFirst: Play today's challenge to unlock the leaderboard.
daily.saveError: Could not confirm the request. Check your connection and retry.
